stations: 65 Luas stops across the Red and Green Lines (Connolly and Saggart excluded - no real-time coverage in the NTA feed, see notCovered).
notes: Abbey Street is the Red Line hub; the Green Line interchange (Marlborough / O'Connell - GPO / O'Connell Upper) is a short walk away, not the same stop. Connolly (Red trunk, between George's Dock and Busaras) and Saggart (Red Line branch terminus) are filtered out of v1: the live NTA GTFS-RT v2 TripUpdates feed never carries a stopTimeUpdate for either stop's static stop_ids, confirmed against multiple live polls during Dublin Sunday daytime service (Connolly: 27 Sep 2026, three polls; Saggart: 27 Sep 2026, 20/20 polls over 15 min plus a further 6/6-poll corroboration, both against Fortunestown/Citywest Campus controls carrying 2-6 trips every poll on the same branch) - real trips' own live stopTimeUpdate arrays skip straight past these stops, omitting their slots entirely, while both neighbouring stops resolve correctly under their own stop_ids. The 'Red + Saggart' direction chip still appears at every upstream Red stop (Saggart is still a valid printed terminus, per lib/cities/dublin/marketing-directions.js's LINE_TERMINI list, independent of catalog/board membership) - only Saggart's own board is filtered, not the destination it names. Per docs/board-eligibility-rule.md, a station with no confirmable real-time service is filtered out of the app rather than shown with a silently empty board. The NTA live feed sometimes has no times for a stop for a few minutes; the app says so rather than showing a blank board (this covers Rialto, which showed the same shape as Red Cow's known intermittent feed gap on Mark's 3-poll sweep but resolved to 10/10 non-empty polls, 5-7 trips each, on a dedicated 10-poll/60s foreground recheck against Fatima/Suir Road controls on 27 Sep 2026 - kept in the catalog, not filtered).
